svg.title: Argo CD service-based architecture
svg.desc: Service-based architecture for Argo CD: five coarse-grained separately deployed platform services — API Server, Repository Server, Application Controller, Dex, and Redis — with clear responsibilities, communicating via REST, gRPC, and Kubernetes watch APIs.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do UI, CLI, and automation tools interact with Argo CD?')
sendPrompt('How does automation connect to Argo CD?')
sendPrompt('What does the Argo CD API Server do?')
g.text: Exposes REST / gRPC APIs · enforces RBAC · manages Application CRDs

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does Dex handle in Argo CD?')
sendPrompt('What does the Argo CD Repository Server do?')
sendPrompt('What does the Argo CD Application Controller do?')
sendPrompt('What does Redis do in Argo CD?')
sendPrompt('How does the Repository Server interact with Git?')
sendPrompt('How does the Application Controller sync state to Kubernetes?')
g.text: Watch live state · apply sync operations

svg.text: App Controller reconciliation loop: watch Application CRDs → fetch manifests from Repo Server → compare → sync to cluster
